text: The economy grew at a 3.4% yearly pace in the third quarter, above the roughly 3.2% expected; September PCE inflation was 3.6% and core 3.1%, both as expected.
Gold eased about 0.9% overnight to near $4,030, about 3% lower than a month ago.
Silver fell about 2.4% to $52.65, more than twice gold's drop, lifting the gold/silver ratio from about 75.4 to 76.5.
Nasdaq-100 futures fell about 1.2% after Alphabet dropped about 10% on its results, while Microsoft rose about 3%.
The 10-year yield eased about 3 bp to near 5.00% and the 2-year about 6 bp to near 4.68%.
The VIX rose about 1% to 17.1 overnight as tech futures fell.
Bitcoin slipped back below $80,000, with about $356 million of bullish futures bets wiped out over 24 hours.
Brent held near $115 a barrel overnight; Wednesday's settle is still reported differently, so its day change is left blank.
